question: Are attempt05 source preservation, native editability, packed-file portability, static GLB export safety, and publication boundaries supported by the frozen artifacts?

reviewer.tools: read-only shell, Python, Blender 5.2.1 background reopen
reviewer.independence_limits: Single reviewer; direct artifact checks, shared repository context.
reviewer.evidence_status: live for current workspace file/hash/reopen/inventory checks; analytical for scope and consequences; not-run for clean remote checkout and browser/runtime loading.

claims.claim: All 21 manifest entries match their recorded SHA-256 and byte-identical frozen package is present in this workspace.
claims.evidence: Recomputed all 21 manifest hashes; zero missing/mismatched files. Note files are untracked workspace additions, so presence is not evidence of commit or remote availability.
claims.consequence: A different file would invalidate conclusions tied to this freeze.
claims.next_test: Verify committed/remote revision when a release or synchronization claim is needed.

claims.claim: Native Blender source reopens and has no unpacked FILE-source image dependency.
claims.evidence: Blender 5.2.1 reopened 1c449c25…blend; reported 81 images, 80 packed, zero unpacked FILE images; 7,285 objects/7,272 meshes. Build script packs FILE images before save.
claims.consequence: Missing external source paths would impair portability/editability.
claims.next_test: No further local test needed for packed-image claim; clean-machine reopen is optional portability follow-up.

claims.claim: GLB is self-contained for static geometry/material/image payload, with limited compatibility scope.
claims.evidence: Parsed GLB v2: 60,272,540 bytes, 13 meshes/nodes/materials, 21 images all embedded as bufferViews, no external image URIs, zero animations; declares KHR_materials_transmission and KHR_materials_ior. Receipt states face/material parity, native mesh unchanged, no texture resizing, static review only and no hierarchy parity claim.
claims.consequence: Viewer support for extensions and desired visual match remain unverified; animation/hierarchy fidelity is outside export claim.
claims.next_test: Test exact GLB in intended browser/runtime before any browser-readiness claim.

claims.claim: Current Vite output excludes attempt05 CG files and production V37 remains runtime model.
claims.evidence: Existing build-proof.json records npm ci/build PASS, 52 files, no forbidden CG/private paths, runtime V37 unchanged; current dist has 52 files and no supervised/CG filenames.
claims.consequence: An accidental public inclusion could disclose an unapproved creative asset.
claims.next_test: Repeat build plus full dist review before any release, per repository rule.

claims.claim: Attempt05 is committed, remotely present, runtime-ready, or approved for publication/reuse.
claims.evidence: Relevant assets and scripts are untracked in this checkout; no remote/CI/deployment or browser load was tested. NOTICE reserves creative rights; build proof explicitly excludes deployment and owner acceptance.
claims.consequence: Overstating status could imply availability, licensing, or approval that is absent.
claims.next_test: Check exact remote commit/LFS retrieval and release authorization only if later requested.

rationale: Local evidence supports frozen-file integrity, editable native reopen, packed image portability, and a self-contained static GLB. Keep this conclusion limited to a local review candidate. Extension/browser support, clean remote availability, complete era delivery, artistic likeness, and owner acceptance are not established.

status_boundaries.live: manifest hash verification; Blender native reopen; GLB structure inspection; current dist inventory
status_boundaries.not-run: clean remote checkout/LFS, intended browser/runtime GLB load, CI/deployment, owner artistic review

follow_up: None for this bounded readonly review; intended-runtime GLB test precedes any browser-portability claim.
